notes:
- **Missing AV** now needs only ONE of SentinelOne or Huntress: a computer with either (or both) is **Covered**, and only a computer with neither is flagged. The "only one of the two" result is gone, along with its wording and its sheet in the Excel export (sheets are now Summary, All computers, Neither, Unknown). Unknown (not in the RMM report) is unchanged. If you edited `av-rules.json`, the extra products you add are alternatives too.
- Full-screen / maximised layout: long text in the front card (client list hint, Manage/RMM file names, folder, status line) no longer pushes the grid wider than the window, which squeezed the section labels so they showed cut off ("ith t", "ptio"). Those labels now wrap to the window width.
